description: Evidence-based rejection and interview feedback tracker. Only exact wording where received; categories assigned even when formal feedback is missing.

scope.label: Scope/Scale Concern
scope.note: Most common theme among interview-stage rejections. Includes ERP breadth, procurement depth, and supply-chain technology ownership breadth.

functional.label: Exact Functional Experience
functional.note: Primarily consulting firms (Deloitte x3, BCG/Inverto) preferring direct consulting pedigree.

industry.label: Industry Experience
industry.note: Pharma commercial, financial services, and Japan market roles requiring direct domain experience.

filled.label: Role Filled by Another Candidate
filled.note: Oil-Dri — not a rejection of candidacy.

unknown.label: Unknown/No Feedback
unknown.note: Majority of application-only rejections received no feedback. Reduces ability to learn from ATS-level screens.

feedback_quality_note: Only 1 of 25 tracked rejections produced confirmed feedback (Combined Metals via Rachel Hecker email). 3 additional outcomes have inferred feedback themes based on interview stage reached. The remaining 21 are application-only rejections with no feedback. This is typical for senior-level searches but limits pattern analysis. The interview-stage feedback is the highest-value signal because it reflects actual hiring-team assessment, not just ATS screening.
